start: Member app with "Messages from my gym" on; the desk sends a new workout plan to this member

steps.action: The desk saves the plan for the member
user_sees: Phone pop-up "New workout plan from your gym: {plan name}. Tap to see it on the Workout tab."
must_not: No pop-up
A pop-up to a member the plan is not for
A blank screen or the wrong tab

start: Member app; the desk saves body measurements for this member

user_sees: Pop-up "Your gym saved your body measurements from {day}. Tap to see them."
must_not: A body number in the pop-up
Another member's measurements

start: Member app with "Messages from my gym" off; a new diet plan is sent

steps.action: The desk sends the diet plan
user_sees: No pop-up; the plan is in the app
must_not: A pop-up while the setting is off
The plan not saved because pop-ups are off
A pop-up for a withdrawn plan

start: Member app; a diet plan the member already has

steps.action: The desk saves the plan again with no change
must_not: A second pop-up for the same plan

user_sees: Pop-up "Your gym changed your diet plan: {name}. Tap to see your meals."
must_not: A "New diet plan" line for a change

start: A member whose number is on two list entries of the gym

steps.action: The desk sends a plan to one of the two entries
user_sees: No pop-up to the phone (the number is shared)
must_not: The plan name of one person pushed to another person's phone
A fee amount, body number or another name in any pop-up

start: The desk asked a member to pay a fee online; the HQ Worker reads new fee requests every minute

steps.action: The HQ Worker hands the request to the server
user_sees: One note for each app member linked to that list entry: "Your gym asked you to pay for {label}. Tap to pay in the app."
must_not: The amount in the note
A note to a member of another gym

start: The desk makes a new challenge

user_sees: One note to every live member with pop-ups on: "New challenge at your gym: {title}, {start} to {end}..."
must_not: A note for a challenge that already ended
A note to a member who left

start: The HQ Worker hands a bad list (an item with no id, a wrong gym id)

user_sees: The bad items skipped, the good ones made
must_not: The whole list refused because of one bad item

steps.action: The fee function is called with the public app key
must_not: A note made

start: The same fee request handed twice

steps.action: The HQ Worker hands it again a minute later
must_not: Two pop-ups for one request

start: A body measurement saved for a list entry with a name that differs from the app member

steps.action: The trigger looks for the app member
must_not: A note to a phone whose first name does not match
